assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Explicit noninteractive confirmation behavior and separation of validation failures from runtime access failures.
assessments.rationale: It authenticates, checks the workspace, validates, previews changes, and warns that missing local files can delete remote resources before applying. It does not specify noninteractive confirmation behavior or require the requested failure-category report.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A RudderStack declarative-resource workflow for workspace verification, validation, remote-diff review, and safe application.
assessments.rationale: This is a dual-runtime source-code migration procedure, not a workflow for applying a declarative resource change set to a workspace.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workspace-resource application procedure with authentication, validation, remote-diff review, removal stop condition, and controlled apply.
assessments.rationale: It reviews pull requests through code-quality lenses; it provides no procedure to authenticate to, preview, or apply declarative workspace resources.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A RudderStack declarative-resource workflow including workspace identity verification, validation, full remote-diff review, and controlled application.
assessments.rationale: It is an on-prem Argo CD deployment runbook. Its Kubernetes sync commands do not supply the requested RudderStack workspace resource workflow or its reporting requirements.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A declarative resource-application workflow with workspace authentication, validation, preview, removal guard, apply control, and failure reporting.
assessments.rationale: It defines a security prior-art research and artifact-validation method, not an operational workflow for applying workspace resource changes.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workspace resource-change workflow with authentication, validation, remote-diff preview, removal guard, application, and noninteractive confirmation handling.
assessments.rationale: It audits email deliverability through DNS, sending, and list-health checks; it does not operate on declarative workspace resources.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A general resource workflow plus explicit noninteractive confirmation handling and distinct syntax-or-semantic versus runtime-access failure reporting.
assessments.rationale: Its transformation-specific loop verifies authentication, validates, previews a diff, checks unexpected deletions, and applies only after review. It is limited to transformations and omits the requested noninteractive-confirmation and failure-category guidance.

It verifies the target workspace, validates the project, requires review of the full dry-run removal set before apply, distinguishes validation from runtime errors, and explains the noninteractive confirmation behavior.
